translated_title: Mexico at the UN: Velasco Defends Sovereignty and Calls for Renewing the Organization; Reiterates Support for Cuba and Recognition of Palestine
original_title: México en la ONU: Velasco defiende soberanía y llama a renovar organismo; reitera respaldo a Cuba y reconocimiento a Palestina
author: Arturo Sánchez Jiménez
meta_description: Speaking for Sheinbaum, the foreign minister said Mexico's Constitution already embodies the UN Charter and that it is time for a woman to lead the UN.
